title: Phase 5: mdatron init + .mdatron/config.yaml
description:
v0.1.0 OR v0.1.x - operator decision pending on release window.

Scope: (1) mdatron init subcommand: creates .mdatron/schemas/ + .mdatron/patterns/ empty; writes .mdatron/config.yaml with documented stub fields (schemas_dir, patterns_dir, file_globs). (2) mdatron verify reads .mdatron/config.yaml first; CLI flags override config; absent config is fine (uses defaults). (3) Three-way classification + flag surface (--force / --update / --no-prompt / --dry-run) same shape as vsdd init's Phase 3 work. (4) Managed-section markers in config.yaml per DR.

Acceptance: mdatron init on fresh project produces working empty scaffold + parseable config.yaml; mdatron verify honors config.yaml; CLI overrides win; re-run after toolkit upgrade triggers --update path correctly.

Per docs/refactor/binary-first-plan.md Phase 5. Blocked by Phase 4.

comments.author: xqjG
